data.summary:
PMP and ITIL certified transformation leader with 24+ years of experience in Banking, Capital Markets, Digital Transformation, Program Management, Change Management, Cloud Modernization and Operational Excellence. Led large-scale transformation programs across Canada, Singapore and India for global banking clients. Experienced in digital product delivery, process automation, front-office effectiveness improvement, stakeholder management, agile delivery, analytics-driven decision making, cloud migration, AI adoption and enterprise-wide change initiatives.
Proven expertise in program and portfolio management, service delivery governance, cloud modernization, and application lifecycle management;  managing front-office and back-office platforms through global offshore–onsite delivery models.
Recognized for building and leading large, multi-geography teams (190+ associates), aligning technology initiatives with business objectives, and consistently delivering on-time, on-budget outcomes with quantifiable cost/risk reduction, and operational excellence.
Strong track record in embedding continuous service improvement (CSI), ensuring service stability, driving revenue growth, business development, while enhancing system reliability, customer experience, and business throughput across Capital Markets, OTC Derivatives, Collateral, Client Valuations, and Risk & Analytics domains.
